pos.personaBrief: Santos wanted the ball and attacked even a man down (Jovem Pan 2020), Dorival: 'nunca foi de defesa, de espera'; team was solidary, with possession as a main aspect.

pro.personaBrief: Dorival drilled one-two touch play up to the last third, then freedom; fast, vertical attackers (Robinho, Neymar, André) and a front three.

est.personaBrief: Sources stress 'ninguém jogava engessado, havia liberdade de movimentação'; Ganso and André dropped and combined with Neymar and Robinho.

lar.personaBrief: Neymar on the left and Robinho on the right with André central (Drible de Corpo); Dorival wanted Ganso central rather than drifting to the sides.

blo.personaBrief: Trivela March 2010: the front three did not help in marking, recomposition was difficult and there was no reliable defensive system; Dorival said the team never waited.

mar.personaBrief: Marking system is undocumented; only a loose defensive system is noted, so answers follow the Brazilian norm of the time with Durval-led defenders.

pla.personaBrief: Dorival built the team around Ganso and Neymar and kept an attacking identity regardless of opponent, shifting from 4-4-2 to 4-3-3 to fit André.

res.personaBrief: Statedview celebrates 'o Brasil todinho dançar' and the essence of Brazilian football; the team did not give up attack even down players.

sis.personaBrief: Team was built on Ganso and Neymar, with freedom from the last third; yet Dorival was a disciplinarian who benched Neymar.

jog.personaBrief: Technical Meninos da Vila, Ganso as classic playmaker, 'futebol arte'; Arouca and Wesley as midfielders.

bas.personaBrief: Title-winning team led by academy kids Neymar, Ganso and André, with a few signings like Durval for support.

lid.personaBrief: Lance: disciplinarian style; Dorival extended Neymar's ban and was sacked for it, and rejected Ganso's refusal to be substituted.
